name: rulesync
description: Generates and syncs rules, MCP configs, commands, subagents, and skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and other coding tools from one source.

skills.name: Generate Configs
skills.description: Generates rules, ignore files, MCP configs, commands, subagents, skills, and hooks for each target tool from .rulesync files.

skills.name: Import Configs
skills.description: Imports existing configs such as CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or Copilot instructions into unified .rulesync source files.

skills.name: Convert Configs
skills.description: Converts configuration straight from one tool to another, such as Cursor rules to Copilot and Claude Code, in one command.

skills.name: Fetch Skills
skills.description: Fetches and installs skills from a GitHub repository, such as the official rulesync skills, with the rulesync fetch command.

skills.name: Init Project
skills.description: Initializes a project with the needed directories, sample rule files, and a rulesync configuration file via rulesync init.
